messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — bring-up for candidate_rerank_v3_int8 shows an NDCG drop on our short-holdout compared to baseline. MRR ~unchanged.

maya: Quick numbers:
```
baseline ndcg@10: 0.376
v3_int8   ndcg@10: 0.364  (-3.2%)
baseline mrr: 0.211
v3_int8   mrr: 0.210    (-0.5%)
```
maya: Holdout size 5k (synthetic queries), candidate pool = prod-candidates-v1. Queries are a mix of short and long. :thinking:

sam: Did you normalize query punctuation/whitespace before scoring? small differences there can move NDCG a lot.

liam: Also check tokenizer version — we recently bumped tokenizer v2.1 -> v2.2 in the bringup pipeline. Tokenization shift + PTQ often interacts badly.

devon: Candidate gen changed? v1 vs v2 candidate pools have different doc ordering. If candidate pool differs, NDCG isn't comparable.

maya: Good calls. Candidate pool is prod-candidates-v1 (same as baseline). tokenizer: v2.2 yes. PTQ config: per-channel, kvpack enabled. Anyone run a controlled run with canonicalized queries and tokenizer pinned to v2.1?

elaine: I can run a 10k canonicalized sweep with seed=42. I'll strip trailing punctuation and collapse whitespace. Quick snippet:
```
def canonicalize(q):
    return re.sub(r"\\s+"," ", q.strip().lower()).rstrip(' .?')
```

sam: When you run, please produce slice metrics: by query_len bins (<=5,6-15,>15) and by freq bucket (head/mid/tail). That should show if longtail doc-ordering broke.

eval-bot: quick-sanity: ran 1k sampled queries against v3_int8 vs baseline (canonicalized). Result summary:
- ndcg@10 delta: -0.9% overall
- ndcg@10 delta (long queries >15): -4.8%
- mrr delta: -0.2%

maya: OK that reduces the gap, so formatting/tokenizer accounted for a chunk. Long queries still show larger drop. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

liam: For PTQ, try per-tensor quant + disable kvpack to see if KV cache emission for long sequences is the culprit.

devon: Also confirm inference runtime had same max_seq_len config; if baseline ran with 512 and v3 forced 1024 truncation padding behavior can differ.

elaine: Running two more sweeps now: (1) tokenizer=v2.1 + canonicalize, (2) ptq=per-tensor + kvpack=false. ETA ~3h. Will post logs.

maya: Thanks — if either sweep recovers ndcg on long queries we can proceed with a targeted fix. If neither does, we'll need a deeper ablation (embed drift / candidate recall). :eyes:

sam: One more ask — attach 50 failing examples (baseline ranks item in top3 but v3_int8 pushes it >10) with raw and canonicalized queries.

maya: will do. sending samples after elaine's runs. thx all :thumbsup:
